name: zentrola
description: Generate images, query Zentrola account information, and manage ordinary members with an authorized Key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images, view Zentrola account information, and manage ordinary members.
interface.longDescription: Reuse the Zentrola endpoint and Access Key already configured for Codex to generate PNG images, query token usage and quotas, identify the current service provider, and manage ordinary members when the Key has permission.
defaultPrompt: Use $zentrola:imagegen to generate a PNG image from my description.
Use $zentrola:usage to query my current-month Zentrola token usage.
Use $zentrola:quota to query my current-month quota.
Use $zentrola:member-management to create an ordinary member and their first Key.
Use $zentrola:provider to show my current Zentrola service provider.
